profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | Backend API Development | M.Sc. Computer Science | BS Mathematics
profile.summary:
Main skillset: Java 21 ecosystem. 

Interests: Backend development, building tools, E2E encryption, functional programming. 

Experience: Software Engineer at Hilton, ZeroPush and Graduate Assistant with published research. 

I enjoy working on difficult problems when building backends, developer tools and appreciate the ability to create complex SQL queries for analytics. Making technology easy to use for businesses is important. Performance matters because all of your users don't have 5G, an M1 chip or an endless cloud budget. I like to use functional programming where it makes sense. I'm a proponent of end to end encryption. My skills are focused around the Java 21 ecosystem.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Develop Connected Room (CR), Hilton's smart room guest experience, and grow it from 500 to 4000+ properties.
-Design and build backend APIs with Java, Dropwizard and Spring Boot in a Microservice architecture.
-Lead the migration from MongoDB to Couchbase to create a better customer experience for Connected Room.
-Create application configuration for test, stage and production environments.
-Build custom test containers and create an end to end suite of unit and integration tests.
-Collaborate with the product, business, analytics and QA teams for business, performance and feature requirements.
-Onboard and mentor other developers.

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description:
-Evaluated students for a custom learning plan that uses Mathnasium curriculum.
-Instructed students in grades 5 through 12 with Mathnasium, personal and SAT prep curriculum.
-Adapted to students’ personalities, assess their feedback and modify instructional methods for their learning style.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
-Contributed to research in artificial intelligence on a project for exploring the automatic recognition of information graphic messages conveyed in multimodal documents.
-Built a tool to predict the underlying message of an information graphic image when provided in XML form.
-Used machine learning with a Bayesian network model written with the Java Netica API.
-Lead team development in an agile fashion with pair programming, work assignments, iteration phases and a weekly standup.
-Delivered presentation outlining project, impact of our results and future work at PACISE conference.
-Leading author discussing the goal of our approach, current progress, results, roadblocks and outlines future work for graphic image recognition using machine learning
-Best Graduate Student Paper Award at PACISE conference.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Contributed to a cross platform SaaS for sending transactional push notifications.
-Improved site reliability by adding database indexes.
-Avoided brute force logins by implementing Devise Lockable.
-Improved site reliability by serving static assets through Amazon CloudFront (CDN).
positions.insights: Ruby on Rails, MySQL and +2 skills
